subject: general
question: Who was the first Indian to join the Indian Civil Services?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Satyendranath Tagore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Satyendranath Tagore was born on 1 June 1842 in Calcutta.
 
• He was the elder brother of Rabindranath Tagore.
 
• He studied from the Hindu school and was one of the first students to write an examination for the University of Calcutta in 1857.
 
• He was selected into the civil services in 1863 and returned to India in 1864 after completing his training and probation period in England.
 
• He had been posted to Bombay Presidency and after a few months had been posted to the city of Ahmedabad.
 
• He was the president of the famous Bangiya Sahitya Parishad from 1900 to 1901.
 
• Satyendranath Tagore is the author of the book The Autobiography Of Maharshi Devendranath Tagore.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Surendranath Banerjee
 
 
 
• He cleared the Indian Civil Service competitive examination in 1869 but was barred owing to a claim he had misrepresented his age.
 
 
 
 

 Behari Lal Gupta
 
 
 
• He passes the Open Competitive Service Examinations to become the third Indian to join the Indian Civil Service in 1869. 
 
 
 
 

 Romesh Dutt
 
 
 
• Romesh Dutt wrote the ICS exam and passed in 1869.
